svg.title: Polygood Wall Tile groove layout: tide
svg.desc: Custom: horizontal waves, 35 mm pitch, 175 mm wavelength, 10 mm amplitude. Units: mm. Lines are tool centrelines; stroke width is the cutter diameter (6.35 mm, 1/4 in single-flute end mill, max 4.0 mm per pass). Groove depth to be confirmed with Polygood. Grooves on the module edge continue into the next module.
